name: quay_ask
description: Ask the operator one question as a card beside this terminal, when you need a decision or an answer before you go on. The call stays open for the answer, up to 100 seconds, and returns {"answers": [{"question", "chosen", "text"}]}: the label the operator picked in a list, which is empty when they only wrote, and what they wrote, left out when they wrote nothing. Nothing is picked for them, and the card has a text box of its own, so add no option for "other".

options.description: Two to six options, of which the operator picks one.

label.description: At most 60 characters, and no other option's.

recommended.description: True on at most one option, marked as your pick.
